one_sentence_story: A single source trace advances through three visible EON gates, keeps its context capsule intact, and closes as a clearly marked S6 paper claim beside a world-trace receipt slot.

paper_claim.text: Paper claim: the S6 construction may be readable as a closed evidence path when its context, torus family, cusp fibre, and world trace remain connected.
paper_claim.evidence_boundary: This film concept does not establish the claim; source pointers, World snapshots/events, and a render receipt must do that.

beats.title: SOURCE
beats.causal_move: A source artifact emits one amber trace packet.
beats.visual_action: A warm paper slab stands on the left with one legible SOURCE label. One amber line exits its lower edge and carries exactly three bright event pulses.
beats.continuity: The three-pulse packet becomes the same line used in every later beat.

beats.title: EON GATE 01
beats.causal_move: The trace crosses its first EON boundary and gains a time marker.
beats.visual_action: The camera tracks with the packet across dark hexagonal terrain. A thin vertical gate rises; the packet passes through it, and a ring marker flips from EON 01 to EON 02.
beats.continuity: The source slab remains in the far-left background as a dim origin point.

beats.title: CONTEXT CAPSULE
beats.causal_move: The trace is contextualized without being replaced.
beats.visual_action: The amber packet enters a transparent glass capsule. Inside, a short cyan hexagonal fibre locks onto it; only CONTEXT and SCOPE are shown, never pseudo-text.
beats.continuity: The original amber pulses remain visible through the capsule while the cyan fibre becomes a second strand.

beats.title: TORUS FAMILY
beats.causal_move: The contextualized trace advances through a torus family and exposes the cusp fibre.
beats.visual_action: The capsule opens into three nested luminous torus rings. The cyan strand travels around the nearest ring, then bends once at one hexagonal cusp fibre. A boundary tick marks the passage.
beats.continuity: The amber source strand and cyan context strand remain braided; neither is discarded at the cusp.

beats.title: CLAIM / RECEIPT
beats.causal_move: The closed path becomes a claim with an explicit receipt dependency.
beats.visual_action: The torus closes into a hexagonal seal. Beside it, a clean card reads S6 CLAIM and NEEDS RECEIPT. A white world-trace line docks into a receipt frame; the card glows only after the dock is visible.
beats.continuity: The same three event pulses become three white ticks inside the receipt frame.

caption_script: 2/5 The trace advances across an EON boundary.
3/5 Context is added without erasing the source.
4/5 The path crosses a torus family and a cusp fibre.
5/5 Paper claim, not consensus: the S6 path closes only beside a world-trace receipt.

manim_plan.coordinate_system: x is source-to-claim progression; y is vertical EON gate height; z is depth only for capsule and torus parallax
deterministic_construction: Set seed=9 and use fixed DecimalNumber values for all event pulse positions.
Create labels only from explicit short strings: SOURCE, EON 01, EON 02, CONTEXT, SCOPE, TORUS, CUSP, S6 CLAIM, NEEDS RECEIPT, WORLD TRACE.
Build evidence_packet as one VMobject with three fixed pulse submobjects; move it through named gate coordinates rather than redrawing it.
Build context_capsule from fixed translucent Rectangle and edge lines; keep the cyan fibre as a separate VMobject.
Build torus_family from three fixed ParametricFunction rings with radii [1.15, 1.55, 1.95] and one fixed six-sided cusp marker.
Use lag_ratio=0 and fixed run_time values; no random camera shake, noise, or generated text.
At beat 5, animate only the three receipt ticks after the world-trace line docks; do not imply backend verification that is not present.
receipts_to_capture: source pointer or World snapshot identifier for each event pulse
render command, commit hash, output path, dimensions, and checksum
frame-level check that the final claim remains labeled as a claim

falsifier: The concept is refuted if a source pointer or World event cannot reproduce the three-pulse path across the shown EON boundary, or if the final render upgrades the S6 claim to an established fact without a world-trace receipt.
